questions.stem: What is the function of arterioles in the circulatory system?

options.text: To return blood to the heart at low pressure
To control blood flow to different tissues by vasoconstriction and vasodilation
To exchange gases directly with body tissues

questions.explanation: Arterioles have smooth muscle that can contract (vasoconstriction) or relax (vasodilation) to control how much blood flows to different tissues, helping regulate blood pressure and direct blood where it is needed.
